answer: The arm-soreness of grinding pigment cannot be inherited, and neither should voting power. Require each account to lock a deposit in its own vault, releasing yield only as an annuity that accrues with epochs of quiet, correct signing. A sybil ring can mint keys overnight, but every key needs its own buried capital, so attack cost grows linearly while honest demand grows sublinearly. Matured vaults carry a jade seal; peers weight attestations by seal age. Farming collapses under its own escrow bill.
